claims: The University of Michigan football program has won 12 recognized national championships (1901, 1902, 1903, 1904, 1918, 1923, 1933, 1947, 1948, 1997, 2023).
The University of Michigan football program's most recent national championship came in the 2023 season under coach Jim Harbaugh.
The University of Michigan football team defeated Washington 34-13 in the 2024 College Football Playoff National Championship.
The University of Michigan football program holds the most wins in college football history.
Under coach Fielding H. Yost, the University of Michigan Wolverines won four consecutive national titles (1901–1904).
Fritz Crisler led the 1947 University of Michigan football team.
The 1947 University of Michigan football team was Rose Bowl champion.
The 1947 University of Michigan football team was AP national champion.
The University of Michigan football program won a national title in 1948.
Lloyd Carr coached the 1997 University of Michigan football team.
Charles Woodson was a Heisman Trophy winner.
Charles Woodson led the 1997 University of Michigan football team.
The 1997 University of Michigan football team went 12-0.
The 1997 University of Michigan football team won the AP poll title.
Jim Harbaugh coached the 2023 University of Michigan football team.
The 2023 University of Michigan football team went 15-0.
The 2023 University of Michigan football team defeated Washington 34-13 to secure their 12th title.
The University of Michigan football program has won or shared a record 45 league titles (44 Big Ten titles).
The University of Michigan football program is the winningest program in conference history.
The University of Michigan football team lost 51-45 to TCU in the Fiesta Bowl semifinal in the playoff for the 2022 season (played in 2023).
The University of Michigan football team lost 34-11 to Georgia in the Orange Bowl semifinal in the playoff for the 2021 season (played in 2022).
